summary: Doc 28 Design Studio MVP fully tested. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass covering validation 400s, list/get with no source_photo_base64 leak, cross-user 404, inspiration style_summary, refine v2 creation, buildability verdict + separated categories + measure_first, approve/convert idempotency. Frontend E2E on mobile (390x844): login as demo_home → /home-intel Design Studio card visible → list showed existing 'Cozy living room' → created new 'Test bedroom UI' project → generated real concept image (Nano Banana) → direction card + disclaimer rendered → buildability verdict card with 'Measure before buying' rendered → approve → convert → navigated to /home-intel/repair/{id}. All testIDs present and interactive. Minor state edge case: refining a project AFTER it was converted resets status to 'approved' but linked_issue_id remains, so the UI on that stale project shows Approve/Convert buttons instead of 'Open the build project'.

minor.issue: Refining a project whose status is already 'converted' resets it to 'concept_generated' (later 'approved') while linked_issue_id stays populated. Subsequent convert returns already:true without restoring status='converted', leaving the frontend on the wrong branch (shows Approve/Convert instead of 'Open the build project'). Consider (a) blocking refine after convert, or (b) restoring status='converted' inside convert when linked_issue_id is already present.

integration_issues.flow: Existing converted project detail (Cozy living room)
integration_issues.issue: Detail screen condition `proj.status === 'converted'` misses the case where linked_issue_id is set but status was later flipped by a refine call. Suggest: `proj.linked_issue_id ? show 'Open the build project' : show approve/convert`

action_items: Optional: harden convert() to re-assert status='converted' when linked_issue_id already exists, or gate refine when status='converted'. This addresses the stale 'Cozy living room' UI state.
Optional FE hardening: use `proj.linked_issue_id` (not `proj.status === 'converted'`) to decide whether to render the 'Open the build project' button in /home-intel/design/[id].tsx (line ~143).
critical_code_review_comments: design_studio_engine.py cleanly excludes source_photo_base64 from list/get responses (projection {source_photo_base64: 0}); inspirations exclude base64 too. Verified no PII leak.
convert() correctly marks gr_issues with source='design_studio' and design_project_id for traceability.
buildability separates taste/buildability/safety/budget/permit/measure_first per Doc 28 spec — LLM verdict is validated against the allowed enum with a needs_review fallback.
image generation uses gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview via emergentintegrations with reference_b64 for room-aware edits — verified end-to-end from FE.
seed_data_creation: Created two projects during testing: refine bumped existing pid ee9deacc… to v2, and FE E2E created 'Test bedroom UI' (converted to gr_issue). Total ~2 Nano Banana images generated (within budget).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + FE for Design Studio Doc 28 is green. Existing demo project 'Cozy living room' (pid ee9deacc-b818-4fe8-8f1e-abf7671d9780) is now in status='approved' with a linked_issue_id set — this is the artifact of the refine-after-convert edge case noted above. If retesting the 'Open the build project' visibility, either apply the minor fix or use a freshly-converted project.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the Cozy 'Open build project button not visible' observation: _make_version() unconditionally sets status='concept_generated' after any version creation (line ~202), which overwrites 'converted'. convert() has an early-return short-circuit when linked_issue_id exists (line ~269) that does not restore status. FE detail screen uses `proj.status === 'converted'` (line 143) as the sole gate for the open-project button. Mitigation: either guard refine when status='converted', or use linked_issue_id as the FE gate.
